title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a stopwatch experiment sheet for the pendulum
body:
## Problem
Session 1 mentions timing 20 swings but gives no table to fill in.

## Context
Comparing a measured period with 2 pi sqrt(L / g) is the best way to trust the formula.

## Expected outcome
A one-page printable sheet with a table for lengths 0.25, 0.5, 1.0 m, the measured time for 20 swings, the period, the formula value and the percent difference.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Sheet added as Markdown
- [ ] A worked row filled in with the 1.0 m values

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette to the live apps
body:
## Problem
The apps separate the pendulum and the spring only by colour; some colour-blind users cannot tell the curves apart.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette and line styles (solid, dashed) that stay distinguishable in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/app.html`, `sessions/session-02/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Both curves distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: chaos in the driven pendulum
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. Students ask what happens when the nonlinear pendulum is also pushed periodically.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Add Session 5: fit a phone accelerometer recording
body:
## Problem
Session 3 simulates oscillators but never compares with real data.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 2. A phone sensor app can export acceleration as a CSV file.

## Expected outcome
A lesson that fits a damped cosine to synthetic and then real data and reports frequency, decay rate and Q.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Fit recovers the synthetic frequency within 1 percent
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: pendulum with phase portrait, energy bars and resonance curve
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a damped pendulum with three linked panels; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Energy bars add up to the starting energy at every frame
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
